name: manual_442afa
claim: The same clustering-before-shipping discipline recurs at five zoom levels and should be applied consistently at all of them: (1) one coherent fix per file, (2) group fixes into commits by theme not touch-order, (3) batch all logical commits locally before a single push, (4) stay on one open branch/PR rather than fragmenting across new ones unless none exists yet, (5) at repo-architecture scale, decide per-function whether it earns its own top-level repo or stays a docs/v2/ subsection of a shared repo -- the same 'does this deserve its own container' judgment, just at a bigger radius.

decisions.notes: User-articulated 'concentric circles of nested batching' during the orama PR #298 CodeRabbit remediation, 2026-08-09: fix-per-file -> logical commits -> batched push -> single-PR discipline -> (forward-looking) repo-per-function vs orbiting-satellite-in-docs/v2 for the v2 oramasys/* split. Levels 1-4 were applied live in the same session (5 logical commits across 2 CodeRabbit rounds, each pushed once); level 5 is architecture-scale and deliberately deferred, not executed.
